description_en: Adds member accounts to Cloud Firewall
description_zh: 添加云防火墙成员账号
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw add-instance-members --members MemberDesc=renewal MemberUid=2580394279020000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddInstanceMembers

fields.help_en: The description of the Cloud Firewall member account. The description must be 1 to 256 characters in length. You can add up to 20 member accounts
fields.help_zh: 云防火墙成员账号的备注信息，长度为1~256个字符。最多可添加20个成员账号
fields.name: member_desc

fields.help_en: The UID of the Cloud Firewall member account. You can add up to 20 member accounts
fields.help_zh: 云防火墙成员账号的UID。最多可添加20个成员账号
fields.name: member_uid

parameters.help_en: The list of Cloud Firewall member accounts to add. Call DescribeInstanceRdAccounts to obtain the available MemberUid values. You can add up to 20 members at a time, subject to the instance member quota
parameters.help_zh: 要添加的云防火墙成员账号列表。可先调用 DescribeInstanceRdAccounts 获取可添加的 MemberUid；单次最多添加 20 个成员，并受实例成员数上限约束
parameters.name: members
